this is pretty nice. probably just for US market for now given the real time integration with bank accounts - that's a killer feature.
Watching QuickBooks increase in price while decreasing in quality year by year... 'QuickBooks, without the popup ads' is already a good enough pitch to me.
This looks awesome. The craft in the product really shows — congrats on the launch!

On your pricing page you say 'growth: request a quote.' ... it would be important for me to be able to estimate the pricing before I invest any time or effort to try this out -- even for a free trial.
This is too basic...something like Business Central offers much-much more for a bit higher price
Honestly so excited to see this type of software move to the browser in general. I use Puzzle.io and love it

Do you have a roadmap? I'm interested (love Linear, hate Quickbooks/Xero, looking for something better, finances are not that complicated) but I want to know what is planned and what is supported now.
Congrats on the launch... On your website I see $50 per month for revenue less than $50,000... Is there a free plan or is it just a trial for certain number of days?

What exactly do you expect a user to accomplish in 14 days that would leave them wanting to start paying you? An accounting period is typically a month, minimally... it is a trial period that really just pushes me away from signing up.
My guess is if you offered a 3-month trial period you'd get over 10 times as many signups... you're likely to lose out significantly with such a short period.
We extended the trial period to 30 days now. The original intent behind 14 days was to force a deadline onto user to get set-up properly and realize value of the product.
